india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: STABLE: CFR survey warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely in 2026 due to heightened terrorist activity. Indian Navy was minutes away from sea strike during Operation Sindoor. Drivers of conflict remain intact. Pakistan mediating Iran ceasefire simultaneously. Probability 24%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 59. ESCALATING: Medvedev nuclear threats continue (Finland/Sweden threats). Russia reveling in Trump NATO attacks. Iran war windfall: billions in oil revenues, sanctions easing. NATO strained by US-European rift. Nuclear deterrence gap widening. NATO frontline states welcoming nuclear cooperation with France. Russia shaping narrative ahead of 2026 NPT Review. 'Russia may not exist without nuclear weapons' - Security Council. Probability 66%. Rising.

china.notes: WATCHING: Xi floats Middle East peace proposal. US re-evaluating Chinese military threat to Taiwan per 2026 report. PLA Eastern Theater Type 055 destroyers completed first formation drill and live-fire exercise. Taiwan records spike in Chinese military activity. $14B US arms deal for Taiwan ready for Trump approval. Taiwan reinforcing asymmetric defense. China-NK rail service resumed. China mediating Pakistan-Afghanistan talks. Probability 28%. Stable.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 54. SUSTAINED: ICBM engine test confirmed by US ODNI 2026 Threat Assessment. Kim Jong Un observed solid-fuel engine test for missile capable of reaching US mainland. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Global distraction from Iran war gives NK cover. 3 consecutive days of weapon tests earlier (Apr 6-8) including cluster-bomb warhead ballistic missiles. Probability 85%. Stable at critical.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1155+. ESCALATING: Russia chose 'Easter escalation' over ceasefire per Zelensky. Russian forces intentionally targeting civilians with drones. 110+ drones launched against Ukraine. Ukraine deep strikes on Russian energy facilities. Patriot missile shortage concern as systems diverted to Iran war. Russia regenerating tank force (Janes). Iran war windfall: oil revenues surging. Probability 82%. Rising.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: SUSTAINED: China-mediated ceasefire talks in Urumqi - mid-level Afghan Taliban delegation sent. Fighting continues worst since Taliban returned 2021. Mortars killing civilians including children. Pakistan simultaneously mediating Iran ceasefire. UN experts call for lasting peace. Wikipedia article on 2026 war created. Probability 22%. Stable.
